title: SP / AI Reward Regimes
hypothesis: SP spectral-layer proxies may help lower-quality generators, while learned perceptual rewards may distinguish stronger generators. MOS 2-3 versus 4+ is a hypothesis, not a measured model label.

rewards.name: SP Richness-v1
rewards.definition: R = G * (0.60 * layer_activity + 0.25 * layer_movement + 0.15 * active_frame_fraction) - shared penalty
rewards.meaning: Five-band spectral activity/movement with a spectral-flatness tonality gate; not instrument count or MOS.
rewards.note: Existing Richness-v0 raw core on accompaniment estimated by frozen htdemucs 955717e8. The fixed-vocal loudness penalty is replaced by the common generated-mixture guard; raw SP and penalties are logged separately.

rewards.name: SongBench-Instrument
rewards.meaning: Instrument realism, synthesis quality and acoustic fidelity, not the number of instruments.
rewards.note: Frozen SongBench checkpoint/frontend; log all seven dimensions for independent cross-reward evaluation. Arrangement is a separate training arm, not secretly part of this objective.

rewards.name: SongBench-Arrangement
rewards.meaning: Artistry of harmonic framework and instrumental orchestration; closer to arrangement richness than instrument realism, but not an instrument-count metric.
rewards.note: Confirmed by user, replacing the optional SongEval-Musicality arm. Same frozen SongBench checkpoint/frontend as Instrument. SongEval is independent evaluation only, not this training objective.

design.primary_matrix: YuE2 / Muse x SP Richness / SongBench-Instrument / SongBench-Arrangement
design.weak_model_extension: Authorized native60s restricted-head extension: HeartMuLa codebook0_head / DiffRhythm2 DiT proj_out / SongBloom final sketch classifier. Rank8 alpha16, G2, AdamW3e-4, beta.01,270 conditions. Exact conditional categorical KL for discrete heads; Gaussian KL per latent dimension for DiffRhythm2. Not full-backbone RL and not an equal-capacity comparison with YuE2. ACE-Step1.5 deferred; SongGen removed.
design.display_examples: Five fixed listening cases per text-conditioned experiment: original valid0/10/20 plus paired count2/count5 style probes, both reusing valid0 lyrics and seed5101. No score-based selection; modified probes excluded from formal train/30valid/test. Native SongBloom ignores Text: count adherence n/a, five distinct native conditions0/10/20/1/2 instead. Full inputs/attribution in reward-regime-examples.json. YuE2 five-case inference queued as181262106.gadi-pbs.
design.optimizer: LoRA GRPO, group size 2, frozen reference beta=0.01. YuE2: PyTorch/PEFT rank4 alpha8, AdamW constant3e-4, single group update; ratio clipping is inactive at that first gradient. Muse: ms-swift/TRL + vLLM rank8, native scheduler. Compare reward arms within model, not implementation equality across models.
design.selection: Hyperparameters/checkpoints selected on all 30 validation conditions only. Test all 192 once the selection rule is frozen; report all preregistered arms, no best-on-test selection.
design.audio: Same prompt/seed and frozen per-model baseline. Training/full validation use short native rollout budgets (YuE2 max600/min200 semantic tokens, Muse max512 completion tokens); these are not 60-second replay results. Long replay target30-60 seconds is a separate inference stage; no padding or repeated loops. Public MP3 only, private PCM24-FLAC for scoring.
design.score_binding: All rewards consume the same immutable private lossless audio per candidate, with SHA256 and duration; public MP3 is a separate listening copy.
design.common_guards: Invalid/nonfinite, <1 second or RMS<1e-5 => zero objective. Otherwise shared penalty = 0.5*min(1,near-fullscale sample fraction/0.01) + min(0.1,0.01*(max(0,RMS_dBFS+6)+max(0,-40-RMS_dBFS))). Near-fullscale thresholdabs(sample)>=0.999. Raw target, penalties and invalid rates separate; learned target divided by10, SP raw0-1. KL beta0.01 is a separate loss term, not included in plotted reward.
design.sampling: Unfiltered temperature1, top_p1, repetition1. YuE2 codec+EOS support with EOS masked for first200 actions; loss uses same support. Native BF16 sampling versus FP32 log-softmax remains numerical approximation, not bit-exact likelihood equality. Muse top_k=-1, study scheduler512 tokens per turn. Different native codec budgets between models disclosed.
design.muse_decoder: Native MuCodec API and patched native chunk overlap; study-local wrapper fixes torch CPU/CUDA decoder seed42 within the existing inference lock for every request, restoring caller RNG state afterward. Shared native code is not edited. Validation uses identical decoder configuration. All270 train prompts <=1384 tokens; all30 valid <=952; plus512 completion and64 context margin fit2048.
design.validation: All frozen30 conditions; YuE2 checkpoints0/50/100/270, Muse0/270. Freeze seeds5101+index and same per-model baseline audio across reward arms. Partial validation is never reported as full mean.
design.cross_scoring: During training/validation: all SP components, all seven SongBench dimensions, peak/clipping/RMS. Independent SongEval, LUFS, lyric alignment and blind listening remain follow-up evaluation, not completed claims.
design.human_test: Blind paired A/B plus separate instrument-realism, arrangement-richness and overall MOS ratings; randomized order and level-matched listening copies kept separate from scored audio. Model quality bands determined from baseline listening, never reward predictions.
design.statistics: Paired per-condition deltas, bootstrap confidence intervals clustered by condition and seed. Test interaction of baseline quality x reward family; account for reward saturation/ranking and multiple comparisons. Two differently architected models alone cannot establish a universal MOS threshold.
design.hacking_audit: Noise layering, gain/clipping, duplicated layers, dense dissonant tones, empty or missing vocals, sparse accompaniment. An optimized score increase alone is not improvement; require blind ratings/cross-metric evidence. Synthetic attacks are diagnostics only, never counted as full benchmark outcomes.
